title: puzzle level (data/levels/<id>.json, or inline in a pack). .txt levels are the mechanic's text grid.

text.description: mechanic text grid: push = XSB (# wall, - floor, @ player, $ crate, . goal, * crate on goal, + player on goal); flow = letters (pairs), . empty, # blocked; lights = o/.; nonogram = #/.; sliding = rows of numbers, 0 = gap

stars.description: par mechanics: [max moves for 3★, max moves for 2★]; match3: [score for 2★, score for 3★]

grid.description: match3 authored start board (rows of colour digits)

fill.description: flow: every cell must be covered (default true)
